profiles.description: Budget review: plan, supplementary plans and outturn vintages of a line as each source published them, payments and audit findings beside them, every figure with its accounting basis

workflow_defaults.as_of: the revision in force by the source's own publication date; every vintage listed
workflow_defaults.differences: same accounting basis and currency only, or under a cited reconciliation method
workflow_defaults.conflicts: shown side by side and flagged; nothing averaged or preferred
workflow_defaults.unmatched_beneficiaries: shown as the source string, marked unmatched
workflow_defaults.award_history: context for a reviewed supplier match only

vocabulary.figure: a published plan, supplementary-plan or outturn amount of one line and fiscal year
vocabulary.vintage: one publication of a line's figure (a later vintage may repeat the figure)
vocabulary.accounting basis: cash, accrual, ESA 2010, commitment or payment, as the source publishes it

profiles.description: Migration and demographic statistics: each publisher's population, migration, asylum and displacement series for a geography and period, with definitions, units, geography level, vintage, breaks and comparability notes, side by side

workflow_defaults.default_geography_level: the level the requested boundary's published code belongs to (Berlin: bezirk; Länder: ags land; member states: country)
workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released on or before the requested date; historical_vintage_unavailable when none is retained; pinned vintages turn stale, never replaced
workflow_defaults.comparability: publishers side by side; unnoted pairs are comparability_unknown; nothing merged or averaged
workflow_defaults.breaks: marked; no chaining, rebasing or splicing
workflow_defaults.other_levels: listed as available at a different level, never aggregated or apportioned

vocabulary.stock: persons present at a reference date (population on 1 January, year-end refugee stock)
vocabulary.flow: events during a reference period (immigration, emigration, applications, decisions)
vocabulary.country of birth: breakdown by country of birth, never interchanged with citizenship
vocabulary.application: an asylum application as the publisher counts it (first-time or follow-up)
vocabulary.decision: a decision on an application, by outcome where published; never netted against applications

profiles.description: International trade flows: a country pair's reported flows by product and period as of a release, the reporter's figure and the partner's mirror figure side by side with valuation basis, classification vintage, release vintage and a displayed asymmetry; flows in products a cited sanctions measure covers

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released on or before the requested date, cited per figure; a figure not yet released is none_reported
workflow_defaults.mirror: reporter and mirror figures side by side; the difference is displayed, never reconciled
workflow_defaults.classifications: other classification vintages only through a cited concordance, non-exact mappings flagged
workflow_defaults.missing: none_reported, never zero; confidential cells stay confidential
workflow_defaults.areas: codes joined only through accepted identity matches; special areas stay distinct

vocabulary.reporter figure: the flow as the pair's reporter published it
vocabulary.mirror figure: the partner's own report of the opposite flow (the reporter's exports are the partner's imports)
vocabulary.asymmetry: the displayed difference between a reporter and a mirror figure, not an error to correct
vocabulary.CIF: import value including cost, insurance and freight to the border
vocabulary.FOB: export value free on board at the border
vocabulary.classification vintage: the HS edition, CN year or SITC revision a product code belongs to

profiles.description: Labour and employment statistics: a place's, sector's or occupation's published labour-force indicators (employment, unemployment, wages, hours, vacancies) per source as of a release vintage, with definitions, seasonal adjustment, flags, vintages and comparability notes, side by side

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released on or before the requested date, cited per value; revision history on request
workflow_defaults.sources: ILOSTAT, OECD, Eurostat LFS and BLS side by side; ILO modelled estimates and national series never merged
workflow_defaults.comparability: recorded differences and reviewable notes; unnoted pairs are comparability_unknown; nothing blended or re-harmonised
workflow_defaults.gaps: missing, confidential and unpublished periods shown as such; nothing filled or nowcast
workflow_defaults.identity: places, sectors and occupations through accepted mappings only; unmapped codes queryable natively

vocabulary.definition basis: ILO harmonised, OECD harmonised, EU-LFS or national, as the source states
vocabulary.seasonal adjustment: NSA (not adjusted), SA (seasonally adjusted) or trend(-cycle), as published
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series; a revised value is a new vintage
vocabulary.benchmark revision: a revision beyond the regular revision window (e.g. the annual CES benchmark)
vocabulary.modelled estimate: an ILO estimate for a country, distinct from the nationally reported series

profiles.description: Shipping and logistics statistics: a port (UN/LOCODE), country or published route to cited maritime series (port calls, throughput, liner connectivity, fleet, goods handled, openly licensed freight indices) as of a release vintage, sources side by side, joinable to trade flows by shared codes or citation

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released on or before the requested date, cited per series; all vintages listed on request
workflow_defaults.ports: source port codes only through accepted UN/LOCODE matches; unmatched codes answered under their own code
workflow_defaults.routes: only series published at route level; never inferred from port totals
workflow_defaults.sources: side by side with definitions; never merged
workflow_defaults.freight_indices: only indices cleared by licence decision; excluded ones named with the reason

vocabulary.UN/LOCODE: the UNECE code of a location: country code plus a three-character location code
vocabulary.port call: an arrival of a ship at a port as the publisher counts it
vocabulary.TEU: twenty-foot equivalent unit of container throughput
vocabulary.liner shipping connectivity: UNCTAD's index of a port's or country's position in the liner network
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series' values

profiles.description: Extractives and natural resources: a company (and its group), a country or a commodity to cited EITI payments per report version and USGS/BGS production and reserves per vintage, sources side by side, with reviewable company, commodity and project matches

workflow_defaults.as_of: the EITI report version or statistics vintage published on or before the requested date, cited per record; all versions and vintages listed on request
workflow_defaults.payments: government- and company-reported figures side by side with the discrepancy as the report publishes it; currency as reported, never converted or summed across reports
workflow_defaults.companies: only through reviewed matches; unmatched companies shown as reported
workflow_defaults.sources: USGS and BGS side by side; never blended
workflow_defaults.withheld: withheld values stay withheld; estimated and revised values stay marked

vocabulary.EITI report version: one publication of a country's EITI report for a fiscal period; a revised report is a new version
vocabulary.revenue stream: a government revenue type as the report classifies it (GFS code and name)
vocabulary.discrepancy: the difference between government- and company-reported figures as the report publishes it
vocabulary.withheld (W): a value USGS does not publish to avoid disclosing company proprietary data
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series' values

profiles.description: Industry and business statistics: a place's published production indices, business demography and County Business Patterns per source as of a release vintage, with statistical units, classifications, adjustment, base years, flags, vintages and comparability notes, side by side and never blended

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released on or before the requested date, cited per value; every vintage on request
workflow_defaults.sources: Eurostat STS, Eurostat business demography and Census CBP side by side; enterprises, kind-of-activity units and establishments are different statistical units and are never blended
workflow_defaults.series: adjusted and unadjusted series, rebased indices and NAICS vintages are separate series; nothing is re-based or adjusted
workflow_defaults.cells: withheld, suppressed and confidential cells are shown as such and never reconstructed; noise-infused values are never exact
workflow_defaults.identity: places through accepted matches; NACE and NAICS only through reviewed candidate links from published concordances; unlinked codes queryable natively

vocabulary.statistical unit: enterprise, kind-of-activity unit or establishment, as the source states
vocabulary.adjustment: NSA (not adjusted), CA (calendar adjusted) or SCA (seasonally and calendar adjusted), as published
vocabulary.base year: the index reference year of a unit code (I21 = 2021=100); a new base year is a new series
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series; a revised value is a new vintage
vocabulary.noise flag: CBP's per-value noise-infusion flag (low, moderate or high noise)
vocabulary.withheld: a cell the source does not publish to avoid disclosure; it carries no value
vocabulary.candidate link: a reviewable NACE-NAICS or NAICS-vintage relation from published concordances; never a merge
